name: swirl-upgrade
description: Adds a 'swirl-upgrade' terminal command: the system updater that keeps what it downloaded, resumes stalled files and retries patiently.
author: Swirl
title: SwirlOS Upgrade
tagline: A patient system updater for slow or flaky Wi-Fi.
long: The system updater with the r152 fixes, for installs whose built-in updater gives up on a bad connection. It downloads only the system files that changed, keeps every file it finished (running it again continues instead of starting over), resumes a stalled file from where it stopped and retries up to 12 times per file. Each file is verified with SHA-256 and swapped in safely; your files in /home/user and your settings are never touched.\nRun: swirl-upgrade   (or: swirl-upgrade check)
